EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Adding Organization Levels Items
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. The following steps will assist you in adding new organization levels:
Navigate to Company Setup > Organization Levels > Org Level Items Select the Level you wish to update in the Depth drop-down menu Select the ADD button Enter the Name and Description Verify the Org Depth is correct Assign parent/child relationships to the item to create the assignment hierarchy for the employee use If you do not assign a parent relationship to at least one item, the organization level will not be available for selection Select SAVE at the bottom of the page
Please let us know if you have any questions, and we would be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
